segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: While Israel camped in the wilderness, the LORD gave Moses a strange instruction — have the people build me a sanctuary.

segments.speaker: god
segments.text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Build me a place, God said, so that I can live right there with you. Not a palace on a far-off hill. A tent, pitched in the middle of the camp, with everybody else's tents circled around it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He told them exactly how — the ark, the table, the lampstand —

segments.speaker: god
segments.text: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: That is what all the measurements were for. There, God said — right there, above that lid, between those two carved angels — that is where I will meet you and talk with you. He gave them an address.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: every detail meant to say: I am near.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not for his sake. For theirs.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So that he could dwell among them in the middle of their ordinary days.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The pattern was carried by a people on the move,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: yet the promise was fixed — God with his people.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Centuries later that promise would take a face. But here it begins as a tent in the desert, God pitching his tent beside them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He wanted to live among his people then. He wants to live among you now.
